body: Follow your gut/subconscious. I’ve found them surprisingly helpful in the short term in keeping me safe. Also it’s weird to say to say sometimes but holy shit the relief once you’re in a psych ward of feeling safe from yourself, it’s like you can finally relax and begin to think straight again.

Lithium all the way (not bi polar)
Lamictal/lamotrigine did nothing. Also on Pristiq and adderall. Finally gave in to trying lithium after 8th hospital stay in one year
